title: Mixed Event — Connected Through SEKAI's Cherry Blossoms — Episode8 Taking Our Feelings to Heart

meta.Episode: Episode8 — Taking Our Feelings to Heart
meta.Event Outline: In the Empty SEKAI, Miku's words inspire a discussion among Kanade and the others about having a cherry blossom viewing party. Meanwhile, everyone in the other SEKAI is also planning ways to make the most of the season...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hm? Rin?
What are you doing sleeping up there?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You'll catch a cold at this rate! Don't you know taking care of your body is a part of being an idol?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, I saw a fragment of a feeling backstage and was sent to this big field with this strange tree after touching it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And I saw you guys there too!
Oh, I don't mean you personally since they looked totally different!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin, slow down. You're giving us too much info all at once. What do you mean you saw us but not us personally...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Th-That's the thing! I saw Len and MEIKO but they weren't you guys...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, could it be that you saw the versions of us from different SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But nothing like that has ever happened before...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm...
So was I just seeing things...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Mhm...
Huh? Are we back in our SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: When did we get sent back?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: MEIKO, did you happen to make eye contact with the others? You know, the ones who looked just like Rin and Miku?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, them...?
I definitely remember thinking that they looked just like them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right?! What do you think happened just now?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I've been able to see people's feelings through these fragments before, but never anything like this...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Was that place some sort of nexus between SEKAI...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Can a place like that really exist...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Do you think we can see it again?!
That fragment might still be there...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It was really strange...
But I felt really happy!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I went out looking for a cherry blossom tree as a way to put a smile on everyone's faces.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So I'm really glad that I was able to show at least you some cherry blossom petals, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, they were certainly beautiful.
Let's hope next time that we all get to see them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO? Len?
What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wait, I know! You're both lost, right?
Looks like I have no choice but to lead you back to the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Len & MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, we're not.
We're not lost.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(What I saw just now...
It was only for a second, but I thought I saw the others. Except, they looked very different...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Does that mean they're from other SEKAI...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I've seen fragments of other people's feelings appear in SEKAI before.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But none have ever allowed me to see the others from different SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Was that some sort of special fragment...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, are the feelings that let me go to that place...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
KAITO...
You came looking for me? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um... I went out looking for you with Miku and the others.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We were thinking about playing something for the girls as thanks for getting our picnic together...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...
Alright, let's go practice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Luka...?
Did something nice happen to you just now?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I can't show everyone the cherry blossoms I saw, but I at least have a nice story to tell them...)

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line:
We're so glad you're back!
Especially since our present made you disappear...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry about causing such a stir. There, there now. I'm back safe and sound...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I thought I saw Miku and the others... But from different SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (However, I've never been able to meet anyone from another SEKAI before... What happened...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Our feelings all came together to bring about that place...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I can't honestly explain how that works, but it could be similar to when everyone showed up here...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Just as their feelings brought them here, my feelings aligning with the others' allowed me to see them.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But... What kind of feelings...?
Oh, wait...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see.
Us all gathering at that tree means...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The ones from the other SEKAI also want to “help everyone somehow” very much.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
KAITO!
Everyone gathered up some cherry blossom petals for us!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm back in my usual SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Cat's cradle...
It's so boring when you don't have a playmate.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Anyway, what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um... I was looking for something.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You were? Did you find what you were looking for...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No.
But something strange happened along the way...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Miku, there's something on your head.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I guess I managed to find myself a cherry blossom petal.
